 "content": "# Continual-ARC: copy a seed template onto scattered marker cells

Observed reusable rule from solved instance task-64d3df70:

- A grid may contain a small seed pattern plus many scattered cells of a distinct marker color.
- Copy the seed pattern, preserving its orientation, so that each scattered marker cell aligns with the seed pattern's marker-colored position. Replace the marker cell and write the other seed-pattern cells at the corresponding offsets.

The final output was accepted.

Pitfall: don't tile a fixed repeating pattern over the whole canvas or extrapolate stamps from the seed's absolute location. Stamp once per scattered marker, aligned to the marker position within the seed. Construct/check outputs row-by-row and retain every untouched cell."
